question_prompt: Q14: How much decision-making authority does AI have in your hiring process today?
panels: Q14: How much decision-making authority does AI have in your hiring process today?
answers: AI provides recommendations (e.g., ranking or matching candidates), but humans make all decisions
AI is used only for administrative support (e.g., scheduling, drafting messages, summarizing notes)
We don’t use AI in hiring or recruiting
AI automatically screens out some candidates based on criteria we set
AI can move candidates forward or reject them with limited human review

cells.answer: AI provides recommendations (e.g., ranking or matching candidates), but humans make all decisions
AI is used only for administrative support (e.g., scheduling, drafting messages, summarizing notes)
We don’t use AI in hiring or recruiting
AI automatically screens out some candidates based on criteria we set
AI can move candidates forward or reject them with limited human review
